redFirst.basis: `node --test tests/diffmap.test.mjs tests/glob.test.mjs` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1, but its output carries no test tally this command reads, so an assertion failure cannot be told from a crash - no test is known to have been collected: Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find module '<outside-repo>' imported from <outside-repo>; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, OLDPWD, PWD; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: .venv - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own .venv and is not watched; no .npmrc to carry or drop

outcome.technical: Added scripts/lib/glob.mjs (globToRegExp, matchGlob, matchAny: **, **/ zero-dir, *, ?, dir/** subtree, escaping, ./ and backslash normalisation) and scripts/diffmap.mjs (pure diffmap(model, changes), readGitChanges via execFileSync: git diff --name-status -z --no-renames --relative base HEAD + ls-files -o --exclude-standard; rev-list --count for behind; CLI <model.json> [--repo] [--since] [--json]; exit 2 on usage, unreadable model, no meta.commit, unknown base, non-git dir). Mapping: areas by meta.coverage globs; nodes by paths globs or evidence path equal to file; entities by evidence incl. field evidence; dependents = nodes one edge away (either direction) not themselves affected; sequences when a participant (node ?? id) or a step m/r/note ref is an affected node; uncovered = new (A or untracked) files no area owns. Prescan untouched. Tests: tests/glob.test.mjs 6 cases (g1-g6), tests/diffmap.test.mjs 12 cases (d1-d12) in throwaway temp git repos; the model file is kept outside the repo. Full node --test: 173 pass, 0 fail. Dependants: docs/design.md and skills/architecture-map/SKILL.md mention diffmap.mjs by basename; still correct, since the CLI signature and report keys follow design.md section 6 and the new --repo/--since/--json flags are additive.
outcome.descriptive: diffmap.mjs maps git changes since meta.commit to areas, nodes, dependents, entities, sequences and uncovered new files, backed by a dependency-free glob matcher.

testsAdded: tests/diffmap.test.mjs: temp git repo cases for area+node+dependents, entity evidence, evidence-only node, sequences, uncovered (committed and untracked), ignored/deleted files, renames, behind and --since, empty result exit 0, human summary, exit 2 cases, pure function determinism
tests/glob.test.mjs: double-star, star, question mark, dir/**, literal escaping/normalisation, matchAny
